tools.name: list_eye_conditions
tools.description: Searches or filters ArkSight's library of 26 eye conditions (Refractive, Cornea/Lens, Retina/Macula/Vitreous, Optic Nerve/Neurological), returning plain-English explanations, pronunciation guides, hallmark visual symptoms, and direct interactive simulation links.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "assess_visual_symptoms" stacks urgency/override words (urgent, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
